title: How long does a Speech Therapy session usually last?
metaTitle: Duration of Speech Therapy Sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn about the length of speech therapy sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network, tailored according to your child's specific comfort and needs.
html: Each session at Pinnacle Blooms Network is tailored to your child's unique requirements. As we take into account the child's age, comfort, and attention span, our therapy sessions typically range between 30 minutes to an hour. Our goal is to ensure that your child benefits maximally without feeling overwhelmed or fatigued.
